entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To speak with an agent, please press 1.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about an order I placed a little while ago. I need to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Spin Class Shoes, delivered 41 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a fit issue. They seemed fine when I first tried them on, but after a few rides, they're causing terrible blisters on my heel. I've tried different socks, adjusted the cleats multiple times, but nothing helps. They're just not the right shape for my foot.
I'm sorry to hear that; getting blisters is definitely no fun and can ruin a workout. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just check the policy for you.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Since you received them 41 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window for apparel and accessories. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

That's great news, I appreciate it. Now, since I'm a VIP member and have to go through the process of boxing them up and shipping them back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? I still need a pair of cycling shoes, and I was planning to try a different model from your site.

That's a very reasonable request, and we certainly appreciate your loyalty as a VIP customer. Let me see what I can do... Yes. I can add a 15% discount code to your account that you can use on your next order. It will become active as soon as we process your return.
Perfect, a 15% discount works for me. Thank you for being so helpful, Diana.

You're very welcome. I'm generating your pre-paid return label now and sending it to the email on file. Just pack the shoes up, apply the label, and drop it at any shipping center. Once we receive them, we'll issue the refund immediately. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's all. Thanks again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
